Natural Claws.name: Natural Claws
Natural Claws.description: CLAWS: +2 to @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Athletics]{Athletics} (climbing) rolls on any rough or soft surface (not sheer steel, glass, etc.).

Survival Knife.name: Survival Knife
Survival Knife.description: Basic tools in handle add +1 to @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Survival]{Survival} rolls

Improvised Weapon (Medium).name: Improvised Weapon (Medium)
Improvised Weapon (Medium).description:
Improvised Weapons

Heroes often fight with objects that aren’t intended for use as weapons. Torches, vases, chairs, tankards, bottles, tools, and other mundane items are frequently pressed into service in combat.

Characters with improvised weapons count as armed but subtract 2 from attack rolls. @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor02gear00.JournalEntryPage.02range000000000]{Range}, @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor02gear00.JournalEntryPage.02damage00000000]{Damage} and @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor02gear00.JournalEntryPage.02minimumstren00]{Minimum Strength} are determined by type:

  • LIGHT: Metal beer stein, fist-sized rock, pistol (as a club). Range 3/6/12, Damage Str+d4, Min Str d4.
  • MEDIUM: Bowling ball, submachine gun (as a club), wooden chair. Range 2/4/8, Damage Str+d6, Min. Str d6.
  • HEAVY: Head-size rock, metal chair, duffel bag full of guns. Range 1/2/4, Damage Str+d8, Min. Str d8.

The GM can adjust the damage down a level or two if the item is softer than the examples above, like a duffel bag full of money.

Net (Weighted).name: Net (Weighted)
Net (Weighted).description: A successful hit means the target is @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03boundandenta00]{Entangled}. The net is @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03breakingthin00]{Hardness} 10 and vulnerable only to cutting attacks.

Natural Horns.name: Natural Horns
Natural Horns.description: HORNS: Add +4 @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor02gear00.JournalEntryPage.02damage00000000]{Damage} at the end of one @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-skills.Fighting]{Fighting} action in which it @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03movement000000]{Runs}, moves at least 5″(10 yards), and successfully hits with its horns.

Natural Bite.name: Natural Bite
Natural Bite.description: BITE: The creature may bite a target it’s grappled (most attackers can only crush their prey, see @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03grappling00000]{Grappling}).

Lance.name: Lance
Lance.description: @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor02gear00.JournalEntryPage.02armorpiercin00]{AP} 2 when charging, @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor02gear00.JournalEntryPage.02reach000000000]{Reach} 2, only usable in @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03mountedcomba00]{Mounted Combat}

Unarmed.name: Unarmed
Unarmed.description: Unarmed Damage - An unarmed combatant rolls only his Strength die unless he has an @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor01charac.JournalEntryPage.01edges000000000]{Edge} like @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-edges.Brawler]{Brawler} or @Compendium[swade-core-rules.swade-edges.Martial Artist]{Martial Artist} that grants him a damage die.

Bangstick.name: Bangstick
Bangstick.description: A @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03shotguns000000]{shotgun} shell on a stick used in melee; must be reloaded with a fresh shell (one action)

Brass Knuckles.name: Brass Knuckles
Brass Knuckles.description: Do not count as a weapon for @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.JournalEntry.swadecor03rules0.JournalEntryPage.03unarmeddefen00]{Unarmed Defender}

Kentucky Rifle.name: Kentucky Rifle
Kentucky Rifle.description: @UUID[Compendium.swade-core-rules.swade-rules.swadecor02gear00.JournalEntryPage.02reload00000000]{Reload} 4. The tight rifling requires four actions to reload instead of the usual three.
